headline: Denied rezoning 12 Crescent Street; continued hearings on 120 & 0 Pine Street and 956 Dwight Street until October 13, 2026.
summary: Residents asked questions about the Comprehensive Plan, including public safety, displacement, and outreach to neighborhoods. The board also set a six-month update on ISO, File# 170, NOD #9, for March 23, 2027. Past meeting minutes were approved, except the 7/28/26 minutes, which were continued until September 22, 2026.
decisions: Continued the zone change for 120 & 0 Pine Street until October 13, 2026, 4-0.
Denied the zone change for 12 Crescent Street from IG to DR, 4-0.
Continued the special permit for parking at 956 Dwight Street until October 13, 2026, 4-0.
Agreed to have the applicant return March 23, 2027 for a six-month update on ISO, File# 170.
Approved past meeting minutes 4-0, except the 7/28/26 minutes, which were continued until September 22, 2026.

decision_evidence.quote: 2. Zone Change, John Borowski, 120 & 0 Pine Street (006-09-018), BL to BH (ZC 2026-9) The Board voted in the hearing to continue the proposed project until October 13, 2026, due to applicant not being at the hearing.

The Board agreed on the decision to deny the zone change request for 12 Crescent Street from IG to DR, citing concerns about spot zoning. ...
